messages:
Maria Zhao: Hey team — short async check for the v2 stability sprint. Can we confirm: 1) SDK PRs merged? 2) Canary window for canary-2? 3) Deprecation banner rollout date? Need owners & blockers.

Ajay Patel: SDK: all core PRs merged to main except rts-serializer fix. PR #4389 is waiting on a tiny refactor, I'll ping in code review. Should be green today.

Toby Lin: Canary window: Ops can open the window Wed 11:00-14:00 PT. Need at least one runtime engineer on call during 11:00-12:00. @Sasha K are you able to cover the first hour?

Sasha K: I can cover 11:00-12:00 PT. Will be on VPN and watching logs. Please post the canary toggle command again.

Kevin Park: Deprecation banner — legal approved message copy. Marketing wants soft launch on Thu EOD, full banner Mon 09:00 PT. Recommend we schedule automated rollback at Mon 12:00 if error rate > 1%.

Maria Zhao: Good. Owners: Ajay -> SDK merge + smoke tests, Toby -> canary ops + rollback hook, Sasha -> runtime smoke & perf validation, Kevin -> banner schedule & comms. I'll own the migration blog post + customer emails.

Ajay Patel: Quick FYI: serializer fix requires a small change in SDK compat layer. Code snippet for reviewers:

```
// temporary shim until runtime accepts v2 headers
if (resp.headers['x-rw-compat'] !== 'v2') {
  // convert old token format
}
```

Toby Lin: Canary toggle CLI (ops playbook):

```
redwoodctl rollout canary --env=prod --model=v2-lite --percent=5 --region=us-west-2
```

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T11:03:21Z :rocket:

Sasha K: Running perf smoke now — seeing steady 95th p95 ~= 120ms, no regressions so far.

Ajay Patel: PR #4389 -> added comment, @Maria Zhao can you confirm the migration tests cover the legacy header case?

Maria Zhao: Tests look good but add one more assert for token expiry edge case. I'll queue the test change.

Kevin Park: Promo comms draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/comms-draft — added timeline and opt-out link.

Toby Lin: One blocker: internal peering to the canary cluster is rate-limited for some internal tests. I'll file infra ticket and add to rollback criteria.

Sasha K: Noted. If infra ticket blocks canary validation by 14:00 PT, we should pause and push to Thu.

Maria Zhao: Agreed. Final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: when your ownership item is on track. I'll collect by EOD and send a short summary.

Ajay Patel: :thumbsup:

Toby Lin: :thumbsup:

Sasha K: :thumbsup:

Kevin Park: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% in us-west-2, health checks passing.
